content.en: A: Good evening. My name is Fabio, I'll be your waiter for tonight. May I take your order?
content.zh: A：晚上好。我叫法比奥，今晚由我为您服务。可以为您点餐吗？

content.en: B: No, I'm still working on it. This menu is not even in English. What's good here?
content.zh: B：不，我还在看菜单。这菜单连英文都不是。这里有什么好吃的？

content.en: A: For you sir, I would recommend spaghetti and meatballs.
content.zh: A：先生，我向您推荐意大利面和肉丸。

content.en: B: Does it come with coke and fries?
content.zh: B：配可乐和薯条吗？

content.en: A: It comes with either soup or salad and a complimentary glass of wine, Sir.
content.zh: A：配汤或沙拉任选其一，另赠送一杯葡萄酒，先生。

content.en: B: I'll go with the spaghetti and meatballs, salad and the wine.
content.zh: B：我要意大利面和肉丸，配沙拉和葡萄酒。

content.en: A: Excellent choice, your order will be ready soon.
content.zh: A：非常好的选择，您的餐点很快就准备好。

content.en: B: How soon is soon?
content.zh: B：很快是多快？

content.en: A: Twenty minutes?
content.zh: A：二十分钟？

content.en: B: You know what? I'll just go grab a burger across the street.
content.zh: B：知道吗？我还是去街对面买个汉堡算了。

content.en: A: Hello, Daniel speaking, how may I help you?
content.zh: A：你好，我是丹尼尔，有什么可以帮您？

content.en: B: Hi, Daniel, Julie here.
content.zh: B：嗨，丹尼尔，我是朱莉。

content.en: A: Hi, Julie, how are you?
content.zh: A：嗨，朱莉，你还好吗？

content.en: B: Actually, I'm feeling quite ill today.
content.zh: B：说实话，我今天感觉很不舒服。

content.en: A: I'm sorry to hear that. What's wrong?
content.zh: A：很抱歉听到这个。怎么不舒服？

content.en: B: I think I'm coming down with the flu. I have a headache, a sore throat a runny nose and I'm feeling slightly feverish.
content.zh: B：我想我可能得流感了。我头疼、喉咙痛、流鼻涕，还有点发烧的感觉。

content.en: A: I see... so you're calling in sick?
content.zh: A：我明白了……所以你这是请病假？

content.en: B: Yes, I was hoping to take the day off to recover.
content.zh: B：是的，我想休息一天恢复一下。

content.en: A: OK, then. Try and get some rest.
content.zh: A：好的，那好好休息吧。

content.en: A: Good afternoon. What can I do for you?
content.zh: A：下午好。有什么可以帮您？

content.en: B: I'd like to check in please. I have a reservation under the name Anthony Roberts.
content.zh: B：我想办理入住。我用安东尼·罗伯茨的名字预订了房间。

content.en: A: All right R. O. B. E. R. T. S... Oh, Mr. Roberts we've been expecting you, and here is your keycard to the presidential suite.
content.zh: A：好的，R.O.B.E.R.T.S…哦，罗伯茨先生，我们一直在等您呢，这是您总统套房的房卡。

content.en: B: But there must be some mistake; my reservation was for a standard room.
content.zh: B：这肯定搞错了，我订的是标准间。

content.en: A: Are you sure? Let me double check.
content.zh: A：您确定吗？让我再确认一下。

content.en: B: Yeah... Here, this is my confirmation number.
content.zh: B：你看，这是我的确认号。

content.en: A: You're right Mr. Roberts, there seems to be a mixup, unfortunately we're overbooked at the moment.
content.zh: A：您说得对，罗伯茨先生，看来是搞混了，不幸的是我们现在已经订满了。

content.en: B: So...
content.zh: B：那怎么办…

content.en: A: Not to worry. We're pleased to offer you a complimentary upgrade.
content.zh: A：别担心，我们很乐意为您免费升级。

content.en: B: Presidential suite baby!
content.zh: B：总统套房太棒了！

title: The Office - I need an assistant!

content.en: A:...like I told you before, we just don't have the resources to hire you an assistant.
content.zh: A：…就像我之前跟你说的，我们实在没有资源给你招助理。

content.en: B: I understand that, but the fact is we're understaffed.
content.zh: B：我理解，但事实是我们人手不够。

content.en: A: The timing is just not right. The economy is bad, and it's too risky to take on new staff.
content.zh: A：时机不合适。经济不景气，招新人风险太大。

content.en: B: Yeah, I guess you're right... here's an idea, what if we hire an intern? She would take some of the weight off my shoulders.
content.zh: B：是啊，你说得对…我有个主意，要不我们招个实习生？她能帮我分担一些压力。

content.en: A: She?
content.zh: A：她？

content.en: B: Yeah, you know, a recent graduate. She could give me a hand with some of these projects and we could keep our costs down.
content.zh: B：对啊，就是刚毕业的那种。她可以帮我做些项目，我们还能控制成本。

content.en: A: That sounds reasonable... let me see what I can do.
content.zh: A：听起来挺合理…我看看能怎么安排。

content.en: A: Tony, I'd like to introduce you to your new assistant.
content.zh: A：托尼，我来介绍一下你的新助理。

content.en: B: OK, great! Let's meet her!
content.zh: B：好的，太好了！让我们见见她！

content.en: C: Hi, I'm Adam.
content.zh: C：嗨，我是亚当。

content.en: B: Oh... hi... I'm Tony...
content.zh: B：哦…嗨…我是托尼…

content.en: A: I can't believe it took us two hours to get here. The traffic in New York is unbelievable.
content.zh: A：真不敢相信我们花了两个小时才到这里。纽约的交通简直令人难以置信。

content.en: B: Yeah, but just relax honey, we're here and we're going on vacation. In a few hours we'll be in Hawaii, and you'll be on the golf course.
content.zh: B：是啊，但是放轻松亲爱的，我们到了，我们要去度假了。再过几个小时我们就到夏威夷了，你就可以去打高尔夫了。

content.en: A: Oh no! Look at that line! It must be a mile long! There's no way I'm waiting for another two hours.
content.zh: A：哦不！看看那条队！肯定有一英里长！我绝不可能再等两个小时。

content.en: B: Honey... don't...
content.zh: B：亲爱的…别这样…

content.en: C: Hey man, the end of the line is over there.
content.zh: C：嘿伙计，队尾在那边。

content.en: A: Yeah...
content.zh: A：呃…

content.en: C: No seriously, I was here first, and you can't cut in line like this.
content.zh: C：不是开玩笑的，我先来的，你不能这样插队。

content.en: A: Says who?
content.zh: A：谁说的？

content.en: C: I do!
content.zh: C：我说的！

content.en: A: So sue me!
content.zh: A：那你去告我啊！

content.en: C: Alright...that's it...
content.zh: C：好吧…够了…

content.en: A: So, are we all ready to go?
content.zh: A：好了，大家都准备好了吗？

content.en: B: Yep, I think so. The car's packed; we have munchies and music, and the map's in the car.
content.zh: B：嗯，我想是的。车已经装好了；零食和音乐都有了，地图也在车里。

content.en: A: Did you get the camera?
content.zh: A：你带相机了吗？

content.en: B: Got it! Did you fill up the tank?
content.zh: B：带了！你把油箱加满了吗？

content.en: A: Yep, it's all set.
content.zh: A：嗯，都搞定了。

content.en: B: You're sure we're not forgetting anything?
content.zh: B：你确定没落下什么东西吗？

content.en: A: I'm sure... we've got all our bases covered.
content.zh: A：我确定…我们一切都准备好了。

content.en: B: Well... let's get going then! I love road trips!
content.zh: B：好吧，那我们出发吧！我超爱自驾游！

content.en: B: Um... do you think we can make a pit stop?
content.zh: B：嗯…我们能停下来休息一下吗？

content.en: A: But we've only been on the road for ten minutes.
content.zh: A：可我们才上路十分钟。

content.en: B: I know, but I forgot to go to the bathroom before we left.
content.zh: B：我知道，但我出发前忘记去洗手间了。

content.en: A: Oh great! This stupid computer froze again! That's the third time today! Hey Samuel, can you come take a look at my PC? It's acting up again. It must have a virus or something.
content.zh: A：哦太棒了！这台破电脑又死机了！这都今天第三次了！嘿萨缪尔，你能过来帮我看看电脑吗？它又出问题了。肯定是中毒了什么的。

content.en: B: Just give me a second. I'll be right up.
content.zh: B：等我一下，我马上上来。

content.en: B: I ran a virus scan on your computer, and it turns out that you have a lot of infected files!
content.zh: B：我在你电脑上跑了病毒扫描，结果发现你有很多被感染的文件！

content.en: A: But I'm quite careful when I'm browsing the internet, I have no idea how I could have picked up a virus.
content.zh: A：但我上网的时候很小心啊，我真不知道怎么会中病毒的。

content.en: B: Well, you have to make sure that your anti-virus software is updated regularly. Yours wasn't up to date, that's probably what was causing your problems.
content.zh: B：嗯，你得确保你的杀毒软件定期更新。你的软件没有更新到最新版，这可能就是问题所在。

content.en: A: Ok. Anything else?
content.zh: A：好的。还有别的吗？

content.en: B: Yeah, try not to kick or hit the computer!
content.zh: B：有，尽量别踢或砸电脑！

content.en: A: Um yeah... Sorry about that.
content.zh: A：呃好吧…抱歉。

title: Daily Life - What’s your name again?

content.en: A: Nick! How's it going?
content.zh: A：尼克！最近怎么样？

content.en: B: Oh, hey...
content.zh: B：哦，嗨…

content.en: A: What are you doing in this neighbourhood? Do you live around here?
content.zh: A：你在这附近干什么？你住这边吗？

content.en: B: Actually, my office is right around the corner.
content.zh: B：其实，我的办公室就在拐角处。

content.en: A: It was great to meet you last week at the conference. I really enjoyed our conversation about foreign investment.
content.zh: A：上周在会议上认识你真是太高兴了。我真的很享受我们关于外国投资的讨论。

content.en: B: Yeah, yeah, it was really interesting. You know, I'm in a bit of a hurry, but here's my card. We should definitely meet up again and continue our discussion.
content.zh: B：是啊是啊，确实很有意思。是这样，我有点赶时间，不过这是我的名片。我们一定要找时间再聚聚，继续我们的讨论。

content.en: A: Sure, you still have my contact details, right?
content.zh: A：当然，你还有我的联系方式，对吧？

content.en: B: You know what, this is really embarrassing, but your name has just slipped my mind. Can you remind me?
content.zh: B：说来挺尴尬的，但我突然想不起你的名字了。你能提醒我一下吗？

content.en: A: Sure, my name is Ana Ferris. Don't worry about it, it happens to me all the time. I'm terrible with names too.
content.zh: A：当然，我叫安娜·费里斯。别担心，这种事经常发生在我身上。我对名字也很不在行。

content.en: A: Those people in front of us are making so much noise. It's so inconsiderate!
content.zh: A：前面那些人太吵了。真是太不为别人着想了！

content.en: B: Don't worry about it, it's not such a big deal.
content.zh: B：别在意，没什么大不了的。

content.en: A: Oh... I can't hear a thing! Excuse me, can you keep it down?
content.zh: A：哦…我什么都听不见了！打扰一下，能小声点吗？

content.en: C: Sure, sorry about that!
content.zh: C：好的，抱歉！

content.en: A: Someones phone is ringing!
content.zh: A：有人的手机在响！

content.en: B: Honey, I think its your phone. Did you forget to switch it off?
content.zh: B：亲爱的，好像是你手机。你忘记关机了吗？

content.en: A: Oh, no! You are right. That's so embarrassing!
content.zh: A：哦不！你说得对。太尴尬了！

content.en: C: Do you mind keeping it down? I'm trying to watch a movie here!
content.zh: C：你们能小声点吗？我在这看电影呢！

content.en: A: All right, people. We're holding this meeting today because we've got to do something about our sales, and we need to do it NOW! I want concrete solutions. How do you intend to drive sales... Roger?
content.zh: A：好了，各位。我们今天开这个会是因为我们的销售必须想点办法了，而且必须现在就想！我要具体的解决方案。你打算怎么提升销量…罗杰？

content.en: B: Well, in fact, we're the most expensive in the market, so maybe we need to lower our prices to match the competitors?
content.zh: B：嗯，事实上，我们是市场上最贵的，所以也许我们需要降价来跟竞争对手持平？

content.en: A: Lower our prices? Not very creative. It'll never fly with Swan. What kind of thinking is that? Geez. Anybody else have a better plan? Natalie?
content.zh: A：降价？没什么创意。斯旺不会同意的。你这算什么想法？天哪。还有人有更好的方案吗？娜塔莉？

content.en: C: Um, perhaps, um, a sales promotion. Maybe a 3 two-for-one offer, or something like that!
content.zh: C：嗯，也许，嗯，搞个促销活动。也许来个买二送一之类的？

content.en: A: What? That's the same thing. Bad idea. Really bad idea. Dammit people come on! Think! The CEO will be here any minute.
content.zh: A：什么？那不是一回事嘛。烂主意。实在太烂了。该死，各位加油啊！动动脑子！CEO随时就到。

content.en: D: Do we have any ideas yet?
content.zh: D：大家有什么想法了吗？

content.en: C: Yes Mr. Swan, we were kind of considering a twofor- one offer to get more competitive.
content.zh: C：是的斯旺先生，我们在考虑做一个买二送一的活动来增强竞争力。

content.en: D: A two-for-one promotion? Hmm. I kind of like the sound of that. It sounds like something we should consider.
content.zh: D：买二送一？嗯。我蛮喜欢这个想法的。这听起来值得考虑。

content.en: A: Yeah, exactly. Just what I was thinking! In fact, that's a brilliant idea! I'm glad we thought of that. Very creative.
content.zh: A：对对，正是。跟我想的一模一样！事实上，这是个绝妙的主意！很高兴我们想到了这一点。非常有创意。

title: Daily Life - New Guy in Town

content.en: A: Oh, I don't know if you heard, but someone moved into that old house down the road.
content.zh: A：哦，不知道你听说了没，有人搬进了路那头的老房子。

content.en: B: Yeah, I know. I met the owner of the house yesterday as he was moving in. His name is Armand.
content.zh: B：嗯，我知道。昨天他搬进来的时候我见到房主了。他叫阿尔芒。

content.en: A: Really? What's he like? You have to fill me in.
content.zh: A：真的吗？他什么样？快跟我说说。

content.en: B: Actually, he's a bit strange. I don't know... I've got a bad feeling about him.
content.zh: B：说实话，他有点奇怪。我也说不好…我对他有种不好的预感。

content.en: A: Really? Why?
content.zh: A：真的吗？为什么？

content.en: B: Well, yesterday I brought over a housewarming gift,but Armand started acting really weird, and then he practically kicked me out! I tried to, sort of, peek into his house, but everything was so dark inside that I couldn't really get a good look.
content.zh: B：嗯，昨天我带了一份乔迁礼物过去，但阿尔芒表现得很奇怪，然后几乎把我赶了出来！我试着，算是，偷看了一下他房子里面，但是里面太暗了，我根本看不清。

content.en: A: Well, you'll never guess what I saw this morning. A delivery truck pulled into his driveway, and it dropped off a long, rectangular box. It almost looked like a coffin!
content.zh: A：嗯，你绝对猜不到我今天早上看到什么了。一辆送货车开进了他的车道，卸下了一个又长又方的盒子。看起来几乎像一口棺材！

content.en: B: You see! Why would he...
content.zh: B：你看吧！他怎么会…

content.en: C: Hello ladies...
content.zh: C：女士们好…

content.en: B: Ah, Armand! You scared the heck out of me! This is my friend Doris.
content.zh: B：啊，阿尔芒！你吓死我了！这是我的朋友多丽丝。

content.en: C: A pleasure to meet you... If you are not doing anything tonight, I would like to have you both for dinner. I mean... I would like to have you both over for dinner.
content.zh: C：很高兴见到你…如果你们今晚没什么事的话，我想请你们两个来吃晚饭。我的意思是…我想请你们两个过来吃晚饭。

content.en: A: Honey, the house is such a mess! I need you to help me tidy up a bit. My boss and her husband are coming over for dinner and the house needs to be spotless!
content.zh: A：亲爱的，家里太乱了！我需要你帮我收拾一下。我老板和她丈夫今晚要来吃饭，房子必须一尘不染！

content.en: B: I'm in the middle of something right now. I'll be there in a second.
content.zh: B：我现在正忙着呢。我一会儿就好。

content.en: A: This can't wait! I need your help now!
content.zh: A：这不能等！我现在就需要你帮忙！

content.en: B: Alright, alright. I'm coming.
content.zh: B：好吧，好吧。我来了。

content.en: A: Ok, here's a list of chores we need to get done. I'll do the dishes and get all the groceries for tonight. You can sweep and mop the floors. Oh, and the furniture needs to be dusted.
content.zh: A：好的，这是我们得干的家务清单。我来洗碗和买今晚要用的杂货。你来扫地拖地。哦，还有家具上的灰也得擦。

content.en: B: You know what, I have to pick something up at the mall, so why don't you clean the floors and I'll go to the supermarket and get all the groceries.
content.zh: B：这样吧，我得去商场买点东西，要不你来打扫地板，我去超市买菜。

content.en: A: Sure that's fine. Here is the list of all the things you need to get. Don't forget anything! And can you pick up a bottle of wine on your way home?
content.zh: A：可以，没问题。这是你要买的所有东西的清单。别忘了任何一样！还有，回家路上能带一瓶红酒回来吗？

content.en: B: Hey, honey I'm back. Wow, the house looks really good!
content.zh: B：嘿，亲爱的我回来了。哇，房子看起来真不错！

content.en: A: Great! Can you set the table?
content.zh: A：太好了！你能摆一下桌子吗？

content.en: B: Just a sec I'm just gonna vacuum this rug real fast
content.zh: B：等一下我先把这个地毯快速吸一下

content.en: A: Wait! Don't turn it on...
content.zh: A：等等！别开那个…

title: The Office - Out Of Control Spending

content.en: A: OK, so now the last point on our agenda. Jill, let's go over the profit an d loss statement.
content.zh: A：好的，现在是我们议程的最后一项。吉尔，我们来看看损益表。

content.en: B: Great. Well, the main issue here, as you can see, is that our expenses are through the roof.
content.zh: B：好的。嗯，这里的主要问题是，正如你所见，我们的支出已经失控了。

content.en: A: Let's see... These numbers are off the charts! What's going on here!
content.zh: A：我看看…这些数字简直爆表了！这到底怎么回事！

content.en: B: Well, um, sir, the company expenditures on entertainment and travel are out of control. Look at these bills for example. Just this month we've paid over twenty thousand dollars for hotel charges!
content.zh: B：嗯，先生，公司在娱乐和差旅方面的支出已经失控了。比如看看这些账单。光这一个月我们就支付了超过两万美元的酒店费用！

content.en: A: OK, thank you. I'll look into it.
content.zh: A：好的，谢谢。我会调查的。

content.en: B: The list goes on and on. Here, this is a bill for five thousand dollars for spa treatments!
content.zh: B：还有很多很多。看这个，这是一张五千美元的水疗护理账单！

content.en: A: Thank you; that will be all. I'll take care of it.
content.zh: A：谢谢，就这样吧。我会处理的。

content.en: B: Look at this one sir, eight thousand dollars were spent in one night at a place called "Wild Things"?!
content.zh: B：看看这个先生，一个晚上在一个叫Wild Things的地方花了八千美元？！

content.en: A: OK, I get it!! Thank you for your very thorough analysis!
content.zh: A：好了，我知道了！！谢谢你非常详尽的分析！

content.en: A: Hello, I'm here to see Mr. Corleone.
content.zh: A：你好，我是来见科尔莱昂先生的。

content.en: B: Right this way, sir.
content.zh: B：这边请，先生。

content.en: C: Charlie! What can I do for you?
content.zh: C：查利！有什么能为你效劳的？

content.en: B: Mr. Corlone, I'm really sorry to trouble you, but I need your help.
content.zh: B：科尔莱昂先生，真的很抱歉打扰您，但我需要您的帮助。

content.en: C: Anything for you, Charlie! Your father was like a brother to me.
content.zh: C：为你做什么都行，查利！你父亲就像我的亲兄弟一样。

content.en: B: Well, sir, you see, this recession has hit me pretty hard; I lost my job and I'm in a lot of debt.
content.zh: B：嗯，先生，您知道的，这次经济衰退对我打击很大；我丢了工作，还欠了很多债。

content.en: C: I see...
content.zh: C：我明白了…

content.en: B: Yeah, you know, I've got credit card bills, car payments, I've got to pay my mortgage; and on top of all that, I have to pay my son's college tuition.
content.zh: B：是啊，你看，我有信用卡账单、汽车贷款，还得还房贷；除此之外，我还得付我儿子的大学学费。

content.en: C: So you're asking for a loan.
content.zh: C：所以你是来借钱的。

content.en: B: Well, I just thought maybe you could help me out.
content.zh: B：嗯，我只是想也许您能帮我一把。

content.en: C: What? At a time like this? I'm broke too, you know! You're not the only one who has been hit by the recession! I lost half my money in the stock market crash! Go on! Get outa here!
content.zh: C：什么？在这种时候？我也破产了，你知道吗！不是只有你一个人受到了经济衰退的打击！我在股市崩盘中损失了一半的钱！走开！给我出去！

title: Daily Life - I’m sorry, I love you

content.en: A: Whoa, whoa, what's going on? Watch out!
content.zh: A：哇，哇，怎么了？小心！

content.en: B: Hey, watch where you're going!
content.zh: B：嘿，走路看着点！

content.en: A: Oh, no! I'm so sorry! Are you all right?
content.zh: A：哦不！我真的很抱歉！你没事吧？

content.en: B: Oh... I don't know.
content.zh: B：哦…我不知道。

content.en: A: I feel terrible, I really didn't mean to knock you over. My tire, just exploded, and I lost control of my bike. Really, it was an accident. Please accept my apologies.
content.zh: A：我感觉糟透了，我真的不是故意撞倒你的。我的车胎突然爆了，我控制不住自行车了。真的，这是个意外。请接受我的道歉。

content.en: B: Just let me try to stand up. SONG: Why do birds suddenly appear, every time you are near?
content.zh: B：先让我试着站起来。

content.en: A: Are you okay?
content.zh: A：你还好吗？

content.en: B: Oh, wait a second, you seem really familiar, I think I know you from somewhere.
content.zh: B：哦，等一下，你看起来很眼熟，我想我在哪里见过你。

content.en: A: Yeah, I think we have met somewhere before. That's right! We met at Aaron's place last weekend! What a coincidence! But anyway, I'm glad to see that you're not too badly hurt, and I should probably get going. I have a nine o'clock meeting.
content.zh: A：是啊，我想我们之前确实在哪儿见过。对了！我们上周在亚伦家聚会上见过！太巧了！不过无论如何，很高兴看到你没受太重的伤，我可能得走了。我九点有个会议。

content.en: B: Ouch! My ankle! I think it's broken! You can't just leave me like this! Are you calling an ambulance?
content.zh: B：哎哟！我的脚踝！我想可能是断了！你不能就这样丢下我！你叫救护车了吗？

content.en: A: Nope, I'm canceling my appointment so that I can stay here with you. SONG: Do you remember when we met? That's the day I knew you were my pet. I wanna tell you how much I love you.
content.zh: A：不叫了，我要取消我的约会，这样我就能留在这里陪你。

content.en: A: Hurry up, get in.
content.zh: A：快点，上车。

content.en: B: I'm in, let's go!
content.zh: B：我上来了，出发吧！

content.en: A: OK, make a left here... no wait, I meant make a right. Come on, speed up!
content.zh: A：好的，这里左转…不对等等，我意思是右转。快点，加速！

content.en: B: Geez! What's the rush?
content.zh: B：天哪！急什么啊？

content.en: A: Don't worry about it, just drive. Oh, no, the light is about to change... step on it!
content.zh: A：别管了，开你的车。哦不，要变灯了…踩油门！

content.en: B: Are you nuts! I'm not going to run a red light!
content.zh: B：你疯了吗！我才不要闯红灯！

content.en: A: Whatever. Just turn right here... The freeway will be packed at this hour...let's take a side street. Go on! Get out of our way! Move, move!
content.zh: A：随便吧。就在这右转吧…这个时间高速肯定堵死了…走小路吧。快走！别挡道！让开，让开！

content.en: B: What's your problem! G eez. Having a fit is not going to help!
content.zh: B：你有什么毛病啊！天哪。发火也解决不了问题！

content.en: A: Here, I know a short cut...just go down here, and we'll cut though Ashburn Heights. Let's go, let's go! Watch out for that lady!
content.zh: A：这边，我知道一条捷径…就从这下去，然后穿过阿什本高地。快走，快走！小心那个女士！

content.en: B: I'm going as fast as I can!
content.zh: B：我已经开得最快了！

content.en: A: Yes! We made it. 5:58, just before the library closes.
content.zh: A：太好了！我们赶上了。5点58分，刚好在图书馆关门前。

content.en: B: You're such a geek!
content.zh: B：你真是个书呆子！

content.en: A: I can't believe that Anthony is finally getting married!
content.zh: A：真不敢相信安东尼终于要结婚了！

content.en: B: Yeah well it's about time! He's been living with his parents for 40 years!
content.zh: B：是啊也确实该结了！他在父母家住了40年了！

content.en: A: Don't be mean. Look here come the bridesmaids! Their dresses look beautiful!
content.zh: A：别刻薄了。看，伴娘们过来了！她们的裙子真漂亮！

content.en: B: Who are those kids walking down the aisle?
content.zh: B：那些走红毯的小孩是谁？

content.en: A: That's the flower girl and the ring bearer. I'm pretty sure they're the groom's niece and nephew. Oh, they look so cute!
content.zh: A：那是花童和戒童。我很确定是新郎的侄女和侄子。哦，他们看起来太可爱了！

content.en: B: I just hope the priest makes it quick. I'm starving. I hope the food's good at the reception.
content.zh: B：我只希望牧师快点结束。我饿死了。希望婚宴上的食物好吃。

content.en: A: That's all you ever think about, food! Oh, I think the bride's coming now! She looks gorgeous. Wait, what's she doing? Where's she going?
content.zh: A：你就知道吃！哦，我想新娘现在来了！她看起来美极了。等等，她在干什么？她去哪儿了？

content.en: B: Oh great! Does this mean that the reception is canceled?
content.zh: B：哦太棒了！这是不是意味着婚宴取消了？

content.en: A: This is Action 5 News reporter Sarah O'Connell reporting live from Washington, D. C. where a protest has broken out. Thousands of angry citizens are protesting against the proposed bailout of the auto manufacturing industry! Sir, sir, Sarah O'Connell, Action 5 news. Can you tell us what's happening?
content.zh: A：这里是第五行动新闻记者莎拉·奥康奈尔从华盛顿特区现场报道，一场抗议活动刚刚爆发。成千上万愤怒的市民正在抗议针对汽车制造业的救助计划！先生，先生，莎拉·奥康奈尔，第五行动新闻。您能告诉我们现在是什么情况吗？

content.en: B: Yeah, yeah, we're here because we feel this is an injustice! The financial irresponsibility of big business has to stop! We're there to show the government that we don't like the way that they're spending our tax dollars!
content.zh: B：是的，是的，我们在这里是因为我们觉得这是不公正！大企业的财务不负责任必须停止！我们来这里是要向政府表明，我们不喜欢他们使用我们纳税人钱财的方式！

content.en: A: Sir but what exactly is making everyone so angry?
content.zh: A：先生，但到底是什么让大家如此愤怒？

content.en: B: It's an absolute outrage, Sarah, the US government wants to give 25 billion dollars of taxpayers' money to the auto industry. These are companies that have been mismanaged and are now nearly bankrupt.
content.zh: B：这简直是暴行，莎拉，美国政府想给汽车行业250亿美元纳税人的钱。这些公司管理不善，现在几乎破产了。

content.en: A: I see. But, many supporters of the bailout argue that it could help save the jobs of millions of hardworking Americans.
content.zh: A：我明白了。但是，许多支持救助的人认为，这可以帮助保住数百万勤劳美国人的工作岗位。

content.en: B: That maybe true, and I for one don't want to see anyone lose their job, but how can these CEOs ask for a bailout when they're making millions of dollars? And then, they have the nerve to fly to Washington in private jets! This costs hundreds of thousands of dollars! And they're asking for money! That is just not right!
content.zh: B：这也许是对的，我个人也不想看到任何人失业，但这些CEO们自己赚着数百万美元，怎么还有脸来要求救助？而且，他们还敢坐私人飞机来华盛顿！这就要花几十万美元！而他们居然还在要钱！这太不应该了！

content.en: A: Good point. This is Sarah O'Connell reporting live from Washington D. C., back to you, Tom.
content.zh: A：说得有道理。这是莎拉·奥康奈尔从华盛顿特区现场报道，交还给你，汤姆。

content.en: A: I hate working on Christmas Eve! Whoa! Get a load of this guy! Come in central, I think we've got ourselves a situation here.
content.zh: A：我讨厌在平安夜上班！哇！看看这家伙！总部总部，我们这里好像有情况。

content.en: B: License and registration please. Have you been drinking tonight, sir?
content.zh: B：请出示驾照和行车证。先生，你今晚喝酒了吗？

content.en: A: I had one or two glasses of eggnog, but nothing else.
content.zh: A：我喝了一两杯蛋奶酒，没别的了。

content.en: B: Step out of the vehicle, please. Sir, what do you have in the back?
content.zh: B：请下车。先生，你后座装的是什么？

content.en: A: Just a few Christmas gifts, 'tis the season, after all!
content.zh: A：只是一些圣诞礼物，毕竟，这是送礼的季节嘛！

content.en: B: Don't take that tone with me. Do you have an invoice for these items?
content.zh: B：别用那种语气跟我说话。你有这些物品的发票吗？

content.en: A: Umm...no... I make these in my workshop in the North Pole!
content.zh: A：嗯…没有…这些是我在北极的作坊里做的！

content.en: B: You are under arrest, sir. You have the right to remain silent. You better not pout, you better not cry. Anything you say can and will be used against you. You have the right to an attorney; if you can not afford one, the state will appoint
content.zh: B：先生，你被捕了。你有权保持沉默。你最好别噘嘴，你最好别哭。你说的任何话都可以作为呈堂证供。你有权请律师；如果你请不起，法庭将为你指派

content.en: A: You can't take me to jail! What about my sleigh? It's Christmas Eve! I have Presents to deliver! Rudolph! Prancer! Dancer! Get help!
content.zh: A：你不能把我关进监狱！我的雪橇怎么办？今天是平安夜！我还有礼物要送！鲁道夫！小飞侠！舞者！快来帮忙！

content.en: A: Hello, Arthur. What seems to be the problem?
content.zh: A：你好，亚瑟。哪里不舒服？

content.en: B: Hey doc. Well, I think I might need glasses. I'm getting headaches, and I really struggle to see things that are far away. But I have always had 20/20 vision.
content.zh: B：嗨医生。嗯，我想我可能需要配眼镜了。我经常头疼，而且看不清远处的东西。但我以前视力一直是20/20啊。

content.en: A: Sounds like you may be far-sighted. OK, then, cover your left eye and read the chart in front of you.
content.zh: A：听起来你可能是远视。好的，遮住你的左眼，读一下你面前的视力表。

content.en: B: Mmm... X, E, R, 3, a question mark, and I can't quite make out the other symbol but I think it's the peace sign.
content.zh: B：嗯…X, E, R, 3，一个问号，还有一个符号我看不太清，但我觉得是个和平标志。

content.en: A: Wow, Arthur! You're as blind as a bat!
content.zh: A：哇，亚瑟！你简直瞎得跟蝙蝠一样！

content.en: B: Yeah, I know, my vision is really blurry at times.
content.zh: B：是啊，我知道，我看东西有时候真的很模糊。

content.en: A: Ok then, head on over to the other room and pick out some frames while I fill out your prescription.
content.zh: A：好的，那你先去隔壁房间挑个镜框，我帮你填好处方。

content.en: B: Thanks doc!
content.zh: B：谢谢医生！

content.en: A: Arthur, that's the bathroom.
content.zh: A：亚瑟，那是洗手间。

title: The Office - What Do You Do?

content.en: A: Oh, look. There's Caroline and her boyfriend. She's always going on about him at the office. Great. They saw us. They're coming this way.
content.zh: A：哦看，卡罗琳和她男朋友来了。她在办公室总是念叨他。太好了，他们看到我们了，正向我们走来。

content.en: B: Oh, man.
content.zh: B：哦，天哪。

content.en: C: Jessica, Arthur. Hi. I'd like you to meet my boyfriend, Greg. He's the VP of quality and safety for a top Fortune 500 food company.
content.zh: C：杰西卡，亚瑟。嗨，我想让你们见见我的男朋友格雷格。他是财富500强食品公司的质量与安全副总裁。

content.en: A: Nice to meet you. This is my husband, Arthur.
content.zh: A：很高兴见到你。这是我丈夫亚瑟。

content.en: B: Hey, how's it going?
content.zh: B：嘿，最近怎么样？

content.en: D: Hello.
content.zh: D：你好。

content.en: A: Caroline talks about you all the time. I guess he must be pretty busy at work.
content.zh: A：卡罗琳总是在聊你。我猜你工作一定很忙吧。

content.en: D: Well, yeah. VP position is not easy, you know. I implement policies and procedures nationwide in various departments, as well as trained junior managers in FDA and EPA regulations. I also have to oversee daily operations of our quality control for the entire East Coast. That alone means I have 1,500 employees under me.
content.zh: D：嗯，是啊。副总裁的位置可不轻松，你知道的。我在全国范围内为各个部门推行政策和流程，还要培训初级经理学习FDA和EPA法规。我还得监督整个东海岸的质量控制日常运营。光是这部分就管着1500名员工。

content.en: B: Wow. Yeah, that sounds exciting.
content.zh: B：哇。嗯，听起来真带劲。

content.en: D: And what about you, Arthur? What do you do for a living?
content.zh: D：那你呢，亚瑟？你是做什么工作的？

content.en: B: I'm a top gun pilot.
content.zh: B：我是顶级战斗机飞行员。

content.en: A: Really, fellas, you can't take me to jail! Don't you know who I am? Kris Kringle, you know, Papa Noel, Pere Noel, Babbo Natale, sheng dan lao ren!
content.zh: A：说真的，伙计们，你们不能把我关进监狱！你们不知道我是谁吗？克里斯·克林格，你知道的，圣诞老人，Papa Noel，Pere Noel，Babbo Natale，圣诞老人！

content.en: B: Yeah, Yeah, we've heard that one before, haven't we Joe?
content.zh: B：是的是的，这个我们以前听过，对吧乔？

content.en: C: Yeah, last week we booked this guy who claimed to be the tooth fairy! Can you believe that?
content.zh: C：是啊，上周我们还抓了一个自称是牙仙子的家伙！你敢信吗？

content.en: A: It's Christmas Eve and I have all these Presents to deliver! Where is your Christmas spirit? What will happen when all the children wake up tomorrow and don't find any gifts in their stockings?
content.zh: A：今天是平安夜，我还有这么多礼物要送！你们的圣诞精神哪去了？明天孩子们醒来发现袜子里没有礼物，该怎么办？

content.en: B: Sorry buddy, you were parked in a no-parking zone, you were speeding, and you have no ID!
content.zh: B：抱歉了兄弟，你违规停在了禁停区，你超速了，而且你没有身份证！

content.en: C: Besides that, even if we let you go now, your sleigh has been impounded and those reindeer were taken to the city zoo.
content.zh: C：除此之外，就算我们现在放你走，你的雪橇已经被扣押了，那些驯鹿也被送到市动物园了。

content.en: A: What! This is unbelievable! What's this world coming to? Christmas is ruined!
content.zh: A：什么！难以置信！这世界变成什么样了？圣诞节被毁了！

content.en: C: What's that up ahead? It looks like... elves!! Elves!! Whoa, they're shooting candy canes! Mayday, Mayday, we are under heavy attack! We need backup!
content.zh: C：前面那是什么？看起来像是……小精灵！！小精灵！！哇哦，他们在射糖果拐杖！Mayday，Mayday，我们受到猛烈攻击！请求支援！

content.en: A: Hello, Fairbrook Consulting, how may I help you?
content.zh: A：你好，费尔布鲁克咨询公司，有什么可以帮您？

content.en: B: Yes, this is Julianne Horton, and I'm calling to arrange an appointment with Ms. Mc Nealy.
content.zh: B：是的，我是朱莉安·霍顿，我想预约麦克尼利女士。

content.en: A: Certainly, what day were you thinking of?
content.zh: A：当然可以，您想约哪天？

content.en: B: How's Thursday? Does she have any time available then?
content.zh: B：周四怎么样？她那天有空吗？

content.en: A: Um... let me double check... unfortunately, she's booked solid on Thursday, how does next Monday work for you?
content.zh: A：嗯……让我确认一下……不巧，她周四已经排满了，下周一行吗？

content.en: B: Actually, I've got something scheduled on Monday. Can she do Tuesday?
content.zh: B：其实，我周一已经有安排了。她能约周二吗？

content.en: A: Sure, Tuesday's perfect. May I ask where you're calling from?
content.zh: A：当然，周二没问题。请问您是从哪里打来的？

content.en: B: Sure, Merton Financial Advisors.
content.zh: B：默顿财务顾问公司。

content.en: A: Oh, actually, Tuesday's no good. Sorry 'bout that.
content.zh: A：哦，其实周二不行了。抱歉。

content.en: A: Do you two have any plans for the evening?
content.zh: A：你们两个今晚有什么计划吗？

content.en: B: We were thinking of checking out a restaurant in the neigbourhood. Do you have any suggestions?
content.zh: B：我们想去附近试试一家餐厅。你有什么推荐吗？

content.en: A: I know this really nice Italian place. The food is fantastic, and the d' ecor is beautiful. I'd recommend giving it a try.
content.zh: A：我知道一家很棒的意大利餐厅。食物非常好吃，装修也很漂亮。我强烈推荐。

content.en: C: Actually, I'm not all that crazy about Italian food; I'm in the mood for something a bit lighter.
content.zh: C：其实，我不太热衷意大利菜；我现在想吃清淡一点的。

content.en: A: In that case, I know a great little bistro. They make a really tasty seafood platter; the fish is outstanding.
content.zh: A：那样的话，我知道一家很棒的小酒馆。他们做的海鲜拼盘特别好吃，鱼也很出色。

content.en: B: It sounds fantastic, but I'm allergic to seafood, so...
content.zh: B：听起来不错，但我对海鲜过敏，所以……

content.en: A: Okay, well, let me think... Oh, I know this great little place. It's just a hole in the wall, but they do the most amazing sandwiches. You gotta give them a try.
content.zh: A：好吧，让我想想……哦，我知道一个小地方。虽然门面不起眼，但他们做的三明治简直绝了。你们一定得试试。

content.en: C: Ella, you took me there last time I visited, and I got food poisoning, remember?
content.zh: C：艾拉，你上次我来的时候就带我去了那家，我食物中毒了，记得吗？

content.en: A: Well, right, let's move to our next order of business, as many of you are aware, in recent weeks there has been a lot of media coverage surrounding this bird flu issue. And it's come to my attention that our company lacks any sort of bird flu contingency plan.
content.zh: A：好的，我们进入下一项议程。正如在座很多人所知，最近几周媒体一直在大量报道禽流感问题。我注意到我们公司缺乏任何形式的禽流感应急预案。

content.en: B: Basically, we need to come up with a clear plan; we need to outline specific actions that our company can take to maintain critical business functions in case a pandemic strikes.
content.zh: B：基本上，我们需要制定一个清晰的计划；我们需要列出公司在疫情爆发时可以采取的具体行动，以维持关键业务运作。

content.en: A: So, what I'd like to do is: first appoint someone to look after drafting our plan; Ralph, I'd like you to head up this project.
content.zh: A：所以，我想做的是：首先指定一个人负责起草我们的计划；拉尔夫，我希望你来领导这个项目。

content.en: C: Sure, no problem. What issues do you want me to consider?
content.zh: C：没问题。你希望我考虑哪些方面？

content.en: B: Well, let's see, there are a few points we need to be 7 thinking about... first, I'll need you to analyze our numbers and figure out what kind of financial impact an outbreak might have.
content.zh: B：嗯，让我想想，有几个要点需要我们思考……首先，我需要你分析我们的数据，弄清楚疫情爆发可能带来什么样的财务影响。

content.en: A: You'll also need to think about how we can avoid any of our employees getting infected; think of ways to reduce employee-customer contact, perhaps some IT solutions that will allow our people to work from home.
content.zh: A：你还需要考虑如何避免我们的员工被感染；想想如何减少员工与客户的接触，也许可以通过一些IT方案让员工在家办公。

content.en: C: I guess you'll need me to forecast employee absences as well, right? And I'll think about the impact this will have on our clients. Hey, what about vaccines? Should we be thinking about getting vaccines for our employees?
content.zh: C：我猜你也需要我预测员工缺勤的情况，对吗？我还会考虑这对我们客户的影响。嘿，疫苗呢？我们是否应该考虑为员工接种疫苗？

content.en: A: Exactly right. So, I'll leave this to you, and we'll review the draft plan in two weeks. Okay, so, anyone want to order some KFC for lunch?
content.zh: A：完全正确。那么，这个就交给你了，我们两周后评审草案。好了，有人想叫点肯德基当午餐吗？

content.en: A: So, did I tell you about my New Year's resolution? I've decided to go on a diet.
content.zh: A：对了，我跟你说过我的新年决心吗？我决定开始节食。

content.en: B: And you're going to completely transform your eating habits, right?
content.zh: B：然后你会彻底改变你的饮食习惯，对吧？

content.en: A: Exactly! I'm going to cut out all that junk I eat; no more chips, no more soda, no more fried food.
content.zh: A：没错！我要戒掉所有那些垃圾食品；不再吃薯片，不喝汽水，不吃油炸食品。

content.en: B: I've heard this one before.
content.zh: B：这话我以前听过。

content.en: A: But this time I'm going to stick to it. I really mean it! Trust me, Carol, I'm going to be a new man in one year's time!
content.zh: A：但这回我一定会坚持到底。我是认真的！相信我，卡罗尔，一年后我会是一个全新的人！

content.en: B: Well, I guess we'll just have to wait and see.
content.zh: B：好吧，我们就等着看吧。

content.en: A: Thanks, honey, that was a great meal. I'm stuffed. Do we have any chips left?
content.zh: A：谢谢亲爱的，这顿饭真不错。我吃撑了。我们还有薯片吗？

content.en: A: Mr. Mc Kenna, do you have a second? I need to talk to you about something.
content.zh: A：麦肯纳先生，您有空吗？我想跟您谈点事。

content.en: B: Sure, Liv, what can I do for you?
content.zh: B：当然，丽芙，有什么能帮你的？

content.en: A: Well, I was just wondering... you see, I know I've used up all my vacation days th is year, but my sister is getting married, and the wedding is overseas, and, well...
content.zh: A：嗯，我只是在想……您看，我知道我今年的年假都已经用完了，但我妹妹要结婚了，婚礼在国外，而且……

content.en: B: You wanna take some time off, is that right?
content.zh: B：你想请几天假，对吧？

content.en: A: Well, sir, I was just hoping that I might be able to take some unpaid leave this year.
content.zh: A：嗯，先生，我只是想也许今年我能请一些无薪假期。

content.en: B: What dates are you planning on taking off? I'll need at least two months notice, so that I can plan for your absence.
content.zh: B：你打算休哪几天？我需要至少提前两个月通知，这样我才能为你的缺席做好准备。

content.en: A: I was thinking of taking off from September first until the thirtieth. Would you be okay with that?
content.zh: A：我想从9月1号休到30号。您觉得可以吗？

content.en: B: Well, I guess so.
content.zh: B：嗯，我想可以吧。

title: Daily Life - I’m Sorry, I Love You II

content.en: A: I'm so relieved that your ankle wasn't broken! I feel just awful about this whole thing. I wanna make it up to you. Let me take you out to dinner tonight. My treat.
content.zh: A：你的脚踝没断，我真是松了一口气！我对这整件事感到非常抱歉。我想补偿你。让我今晚请你吃饭吧，我请客。

content.en: B: That sounds great! I'd love to! Here is my address. Pick me up at eight?
content.zh: B：太好了！我很乐意！这是我的地址。八点来接我？

content.en: A: Perfect!
content.zh: A：完美！

content.en: B: Thank you for such a lovely evening! The food was amazing, and I had a great time.
content.zh: B：谢谢你给了我这么一个美好的夜晚！食物很棒，我玩得很开心。

content.en: A: Me too. You look so beautiful tonight! I wish this night would never end. There's something I have to tell you...
content.zh: A：我也是。你今晚看起来真美！我希望这个夜晚永远不会结束。我有件事必须告诉你……

content.en: B: What is it?
content.zh: B：什么事？

content.en: A: I woke up today thinking this would be just like any other ordinary day, but I was wrong. A twist of fate brought us together. I crashed into your life and you into mine, and this may sound crazy, but I'm falling
content.zh: A：今天醒来时我以为这会是又一个平凡的日子，但我错了。命运的转折让我们相遇。我闯进了你的生活，你也闯进了我的，这听起来也许很疯狂，但我正在沦陷……

content.en: A: Dad, I'd like to borrow some money.
content.zh: A：爸，我想借点钱。

content.en: B: Sure, Johnny, how much do you need? five bucks?
content.zh: B：没问题，强尼，你需要多少？五块钱？

content.en: A: Come on, Dad, I need thirty thousand. I wanna get into the market. You know, I'm tired of hearing all this news about the economic downturn, the inevitable recession, people stuffing their money in their mattresses. I look at this as an opportunity. This is a chance for me to get a jump start on building my nest egg.
content.zh: A：别这样爸，我要三万。我想进入股市。你知道，我听够了所有关于经济衰退、不可避免的萧条、人们把钱塞到床垫里的新闻。我反而把这看作一个机会。这是让我抢先起步积累养老金的好机会。

content.en: B: I don't know about that; with all the uncertainty in the markets right now, it would be a very unwise decision to invest. I don't know if you're aware son, but there has been a lot of turmoil in the markets recently. There have already been half a million layoffs in the last few months, and we have no idea how the proposed stimulus package will impact the economy. There's just too much instability. I wouldn't feel comfortable investing in this climate.
content.zh: B：这个我不太确定；现在市场有太多不确定性了，投资将是一个非常不明智的决定。儿子，我不知道你是否了解，最近市场动荡很大。过去几个月已经有五十万人被裁员了，而且我们还不知道提出的经济刺激方案会对经济产生什么影响。有太多不稳定性了。在这种环境下投资，我无法安心。

content.en: A: But look at it this way, every challenge is an opportunity. And anyway, I'm not talking about investing 8 in the domestic market. There are emerging markets that promise great returns. Look at China, for example; they have 1.4 billion people, half a billion of whom have recently entered the middle class. Here alone, the aggregate demand for consumer goods re Presents an amazing wealth generating opportunity.
content.zh: A：但换个角度看，每个挑战都是机遇。再说了，我不是在说投资国内市场。有一些新兴市场承诺了很高的回报。比如中国，他们有14亿人口，其中五亿最近进入了中产阶级。光是这一点，消费品的总需求就代表了一个令人难以置信的财富创造机会。

content.en: B: Come on, son, you're looking at this too naively, the Chinese market has exhibited a great deal of instability, and their currency has been devalued by almost a whole percentage point.
content.zh: B：得了吧儿子，你看得太天真了，中国市场表现出了很大的不稳定性，他们的货币已经贬值了将近一个百分点。

content.en: A: Fine, then! If that's the way you feel, so be it. But you're losing out on a great opportunity here. I'm going to go hit up Mum for the cash.
content.zh: A：好吧，算了！如果你是这样想的，那就这样吧。但你正在错失一个巨大的机会。我去找妈妈要钱。

title: Daily Life - New Guy in Town II

content.en: A: Oh, Armand, thank you for such a thoughtful invitation! It's really very nice of you to invite us over for dinner, don't you think so, Ellen?
content.zh: A：哦，阿尔芒，谢谢你这么贴心的邀请！你邀请我们来吃晚饭真是太好了，你说呢，艾伦？

content.en: B: Oh, yes of course! We'd love to come over. Can I bring anything?
content.zh: B：哦，当然是的！我们很愿意过来。需要我带什么吗？

content.en: C: No, don't worry about it; I'll take care of everything. I'll see you tonight. Come with an appetite... I know I will!
content.zh: C：不用，别担心；我会搞定一切的。今晚见。带着好胃口来……我知道我一定会有！

content.en: B: I don't want go over to his place for dinner! He gives me the creeps! Why on earth did you accept?
content.zh: B：我不想去他家吃晚饭！他让我毛骨悚然！你到底为什么要答应？

content.en: A: Oh come on Ellen, it will be nice to get to know him. Besides, he's new to the neighborhood, and it would berude to decline his invitation.
content.zh: A：哦算了艾伦，认识一下他也挺好啊。再说了，他刚搬来这个社区，拒绝他的邀请会很不礼貌。

content.en: B: I guess so... You always rope me into things likethis!
content.zh: B：我想也是……你总是这样把我拉下水！

content.en: C: Ladies! Thank you for coming! You look delicious... Imean beautiful. Please come in.
content.zh: C：女士们！感谢你们光临！你们看起来真美味……我是说真美。请进。

content.en: A: Oh Oh Armand! You are too kind!
content.zh: A：哦阿尔芒！你太客气了！

content.en: B: How did I get myself into this...
content.zh: B：我怎么会把自己弄到这种地步……

content.en: A: Hello, Samantha speaking.
content.zh: A：你好，我是萨曼莎。

content.en: B: Hi Samantha. This is Angela calling.
content.zh: B：嗨萨曼莎，我是安吉拉。

content.en: A: Oh, hi Angela, what's up?
content.zh: A：哦嗨安吉拉，怎么了？

content.en: B: I'm just calling about our meeting today. I wonder, is it possible to reschedule our appointment in the afternoon? I have a bit of an emergency that I need to take care of.
content.zh: B：我就是打电话说今天开会的事。我想问一下，能不能把下午的约重新安排一下？我有点急事需要处理。

content.en: A: Let me see, it shouldn't be too much of a problem...
content.zh: A：我看看，应该没什么大问题……

content.en: B: I'm really sorry, I hope it doesn't inconvenience you too much, it's just this thing came up, and...
content.zh: B：真的很抱歉，希望没有太打扰到你，只是突然出了这件事，而且……

content.en: A: Angela, you know what, I can't make it to our meeting, either. Why don't we postpone it to tomorrow afternoon at the same time?
content.zh: A：安吉拉，其实，我也赴不了会了。要不我们推迟到明天下午同一时间？

content.en: B: Sounds great. See you tomorrow.
content.zh: B：听起来不错。明天见。

content.en: C: Angela.. Angela, look up! See that lady over there who is trying on a red leather jacket? Isn't that Samantha?
content.zh: C：安吉拉……安吉拉，快看！看到那边那个在试穿红色皮夹克的女人了吗？那不是萨曼莎吗？

content.en: B: What? No wonder she told me she couldn't make it to the meeting, oh, no, I think she saw me...
content.zh: B：什么？难怪她跟我说她来不了会，哦不，我想她看到我了……

title: Daily Life - Opening a Bank Account

content.en: A: Next, please. May I help you, sir?
content.zh: A：下一位。有什么可以帮您，先生？

content.en: B: Hello, yes, I'd like to open a bank account.
content.zh: B：你好，是的，我想开一个银行账户。

content.en: A: Certainly, I can can help you with that. What type of account would you like to open? A chequing or a savings account?
content.zh: A：当然，我可以帮您办理。您想开哪种类型的账户？支票账户还是储蓄账户？

content.en: B: What What features do they offer?
content.zh: B：它们各有什么特点？

content.en: A: Well, if you just take a look here, see, with our chequing account, you can have unlimited daily transactions for a small monthly fee, and our savings account has a higher interest rate, but you must carry a minimum balance of $ 10,000 dollars.
content.zh: A：嗯，您看看这个，我们的支票账户每月只需支付少量费用就可以享受无限次的日常交易，而我们的储蓄账户利率更高，但您必须保持最低1万美元的余额。

content.en: B: I see, well, I think I'm more interested in a chequing account; I like to have easy access to my money.
content.zh: B：我明白了，嗯，我想我对支票账户更感兴趣；我喜欢能方便地取用我的钱。

content.en: A: Alright, then, with this chequing account you'll be issued a debit card and a cheque book. Will you require overdraft protection? There is an extra fee for that.
content.zh: A：好的，那么有了这个支票账户，您将获得一张借记卡和一本支票簿。您需要透支保护吗？那需要额外收费。

content.en: B: No, that won't be necessary.
content.zh: B：不用了，不需要。

content.en: A: In that case, I'll get you to fill out this paperwork; I'll need your social insurance number, and two pieces of government ID. If you could just sign here, and here, and here; we'll be all set. Would you like to make a deposit today?
content.zh: A：那么，我来帮您填好这些表格；我需要您的社会保险号和两份政府颁发的身份证件。请在这里、这里和这里签字，就好了。您今天要存款吗？

content.en: B: Yes, I'd like to deposit one billion dollars.
content.zh: B：是的，我想存十亿美元。

content.en: A: Has the game started yet?
content.zh: A：比赛开始了吗？

content.en: B: Yeah, about 5 minutes ago.
content.zh: B：嗯，大约五分钟前开始的。

content.en: A: Who's winning?
content.zh: A：谁领先？

content.en: B: The Bulls, of course!
content.zh: B：当然是公牛队！

content.en: A: What! That wasn't a foul! C'mon, ref!
content.zh: A：什么！那不是犯规！拜托，裁判！

content.en: B: Don't worry, Shaq always screws up free throws.
content.zh: B：别担心，奥尼尔罚球从来不准。

content.en: A: You were right! He didn't make the shot!
content.zh: A：你说对了！他没投进！

content.en: B: That was a great shot! A three pointer, yeah!
content.zh: B：漂亮！一个三分球，耶！

content.en: A: Did you see that? He traveled and the ref didn't call it!
content.zh: A：你看到了吗？他走步了，裁判居然没吹！

content.en: B: This ref needs glasses. Hey ref, open your eyes! I can't believe he didn't see that!
content.zh: B：这个裁判需要配副眼镜了。嘿裁判，睁大你的眼睛！我真不敢相信他居然没看到！

content.en: A: Okay... end of the first qua rter... Alright, I'm gonna make a beer run.
content.zh: A：好吧……第一节结束……好了，我去买点啤酒。

content.en: A: This is Madeline Wright, for BCC News reporting live from Washington D. C. where, very shortly, the new President will deliver his inaugural address. Just moments ago, the President was sworn-in to office; following the United States Constitution the President swore an oath to faithfully execute the office of the presidency.
content.zh: A：我是麦德琳·赖特，BCC新闻从华盛顿特区现场报道，新总统即将在这里发表就职演说。就在刚才，总统宣誓就职；根据美国宪法，总统宣誓将忠实履行总统职务。

content.en: B: And what exactly is going on now, Madeline?
content.zh: B：麦德琳，现在具体是什么情况？

content.en: A: Well, Tom, true to American tradition, the band has just played "Hail to the Chief", and the President has been honored by a 21-gun salute. Now we're waiting for the President to take to the stag e and deliver his speech. Tom, it's like a who's who of the political world here on Capital Hill, with dignitaries representing several different countries.
content.zh: A：嗯，汤姆，按照美国传统，乐队刚刚演奏了《向统帅致敬》，总统接受了21响礼炮的致敬。现在我们在等待总统上台发表演讲。汤姆，国会山上仿佛是政界名人录，有来自多个国家的政要代表出席。

content.en: B: What's the mood on the ground like, Madeline?
content.zh: B：现场的气氛怎么样，麦德琳？

content.en: A: In a word, the mood here is electric. The excitement in the air is palpable; I've never seen a larger crowd here on Capital Hill, and the audience is shouting, crying, and embracing each other. On this, a most historic day, you can feel the hope and the excitement in the air. The 20th of January will go down in history as the... Oh, Tom, it looks like the President is about to begin...
content.zh: A：一言以蔽之，现场气氛令人激动。空气中都能感受到兴奋；我从未在国会山上见过这么多的人群，观众们在欢呼、哭泣、互相拥抱。在这个历史性的日子里，你能感受到空气中弥漫的希望和兴奋。1月20日将作为……哦汤姆，看起来总统要开始了……

content.en: C: My fellow Americans, today I stand before you...
content.zh: C：我的美国同胞们，今天我站在你们面前……

title: Daily Life - He’s not a Good Fit

content.en: A: So, Lauren, I just wanted to talk to you quickly about our new customer support representative, Jason Huntley.
content.zh: A：那么，劳伦，我想跟你快速聊一下我们新的客户支持代表，杰森·亨特利。

content.en: B: Sure, what's up?
content.zh: B：当然，怎么了？

content.en: A: Basically, I've got a few concerns about him, and the bottom line is, I don't think he's a good fit for our company.
content.zh: A：基本上，我对他有一些担忧，归根结底就是，我觉得他不适合我们公司。

content.en: B: Okay... what makes you say that? I thought you were pleased with his overall performance. Didn't you just tell me last week how impressed you were with his attitude?
content.zh: B：好吧……是什么让你这么说？我以为你对他总体表现很满意。你上周不是才跟我说你对他的态度印象深刻吗？

content.en: A: Yeah, his attitude is great, but he's really unreliable. Sometimes he's really produc tive, but then other times... take last Tuesday for instance, he was forty-five minutes late for our morning meeting!
content.zh: A：是啊，他的态度是很好，但他真的很不可靠。有时他效率很高，但有时候……就拿上周二来说，他开早会迟到了四十五分钟！

content.en: B: Well, I'm sure he had a perfectly good reason...
content.zh: B：嗯，我相信他一定有充分的理由……

content.en: A: But that's not the only thing... you know, he really doesn't have the best work ethic, I'm constantly catching him on MSN and Facebook when he should be talking to clients.
content.zh: A：但这还不是唯一的……你知道，他的工作态度真的不太好，我经常抓到他本该跟客户沟通的时候在刷MSN和Facebook。

content.en: B: Yeah, but come on, Geoff, as if you don't check Facebook at work. Look, you hired this guy, we've invested a lot of time and money in his training, so now it's up to you to coach him. Make it work, Geoff!
content.zh: B：是啊，但是，拜托，杰夫，好像你自己上班不刷Facebook似的。听着，这人是你招的，我们在他的培训上投入了大量时间和金钱，所以现在你得负责带好他。想办法搞定，杰夫！

content.en: A: Make it work, Geoff. You would say that, wouldn't you, he is your cousin; what a jerk, make me hire your stupid, useless, cousin.
content.zh: A：想办法搞定，杰夫。你当然会这么说了，他是你表弟；真是个混蛋，逼我雇你那又蠢又没用的表弟。

title: I’m Sorry, I Love You III

content.en: A: Steven! Where have you been? I've been trying to get a hold of you for hours!
content.zh: A：史蒂文！你去哪了？我已经找了你几个小时了！

content.en: B: I... um... there was an emergency at work, so...
content.zh: B：我……嗯……工作上出了紧急情况，所以……

content.en: A: I was waiting for you in the restaurant for three hours! And you didn't even have the decency to call me! Do you have any idea how embarrassed I was?
content.zh: A：我在餐厅等了你三个小时！你甚至连打个电话给我的礼貌都没有！你知道我有多尴尬吗？

content.en: B: Honey, I promise this won't happen again, it's just that I...
content.zh: B：亲爱的，我保证不会再这样了，只是我……

content.en: A: Yeah, right. I've heard it all before. I'm not going to take any more of your empty promises. This is the 5th time you've stood me up in two weeks! You need to get your priorities straight. I'm tired of you putting your job first all the time!
content.zh: A：是啊，说得好。这些话我早就听腻了。我不会再接受你这些空洞的承诺了。这是两周内你第五次放我鸽子了！你得把事情的轻重缓急搞清楚。我受够了你总把工作放在第一位！

content.en: B: Come on, Veronica, that's not fair. I do care about you a lot, you know that. I tried to...
content.zh: B：拜托，维罗妮卡，这不公平。我真的很在乎你，你知道的。我想……

content.en: A: You know what? Maybe we should just take a break. I need some time to think about where this relationship is heading.
content.zh: A：知道吗？也许我们应该先冷静一段时间。我需要一些时间来思考这段关系的走向。

content.en: B: But... Veronica, would you just listen to me? There was a fire alarm at my office building today and I was stuck...
content.zh: B：但是……维罗妮卡，你就不能听我说吗？今天我办公楼发生了消防警报，我被困在了……

content.en: A: I'm so excited about Chinese New Year! When do I get to visit Grandma? Grandma makes the best dumplings in the world!
content.zh: A：我对中国新年太期待了！我什么时候能去看奶奶？奶奶做的饺子是全世界最好吃的！

content.en: B: Ha ha, right. Sounds to me like you're more excited about the dumplings than seeing your Grandma.
content.zh: B：哈哈，好吧。听起来你好像对饺子的期待比见奶奶还多。

content.en: A: Of course I miss Grandma, too. I bet she's gonna teach me how to play Mahjong! Hey, Dad, are you going to buy me firecrackers this year? We're going to have the best fireworks! I'm really looki ng forward to lighting them!
content.zh: A：我当然也想奶奶啦。我打赌她会教我打麻将！嘿，爸，今年你会给我买鞭炮吗？我们要放最棒的烟花！我真的很期待点它们！

content.en: B: Son, firecrackers aren't toys; they're dangerous!
content.zh: B：儿子，鞭炮不是玩具；它们很危险！

content.en: A: No, fireworks are awesome!
content.zh: A：不，烟花太酷了！

content.en: B: Whoa, don't you remember? Last year when I set off the firecrackers, you covered both your ears and hid behind your mother?
content.zh: B：哇哦，你不记得了吗？去年我放鞭炮的时候，你捂着耳朵躲在你妈妈身后？

content.en: A: Dad! I was scared because... because I saw a bug. That's all.
content.zh: A：爸！我当时害怕是因为……因为我看到了一只虫子。就是这样。

content.en: B: Hahaha... really?
content.zh: B：哈哈哈……真的？

content.en: A: Oh, and I can't wait to watch the dragon dance! Dad, can I sit on your shoulders this time?
content.zh: A：哦，而且我等不及要看舞龙了！爸，这次我能坐在你肩膀上看吗？

content.en: B: Hey, I offered last year...
content.zh: B：嘿，我去年就提过了……

content.en: A: Well, I... anyways, I was just thinking of the red envelopes. I wanna make a list of all the things I'm gonna buy with my red envelope money! I can't wait! I'm gonna have so much money! Mom, can I get a pen and a piece of paper?
content.zh: A：嗯，我……不管了，我只是在想红包的事。我想列个清单，把我要用红包钱买的东西都写下来！我快等不及了！我要有好多钱了！妈，能给我一支笔和一张纸吗？

content.en: A: I want a new transformer, no, two transformers...the Optimus Prime, and...maybe the wheeljack? I'll get a PSP game, hahaha, and I'll buy the entire class lunch at Mac Donald's...
content.zh: A：我要一个新的变形金刚，不，要两个……擎天柱，还有……也许轮杰克？我要买一个PSP游戏，哈哈哈，我还要请全班同学在麦当劳吃午饭……

content.en: A: Hi there, can I help you folks?
content.zh: A：你们好，有什么能帮你们的吗？

content.en: B: I'm just browsing; seeing what's on the lot. My daughter wants a car for her birthday, you know how it is.
content.zh: B：我只是随便看看；看看场上有什么车。我女儿生日想要一辆车，你懂的。

content.en: C: Dad! I'm sixteen already an d I'm, like, the only one at school who doesn't have a car!
content.zh: C：爸！我都十六岁了，我几乎是全校唯一没有车的人了！

content.en: A: She is right, you know. Kids these days all have cars. Let me show you something we just got in: a 1996 sedan. Excellent gas mileage, it has dual airbags and anti lock brakes; a perfect vehicle for a young driver.
content.zh: A：她说得对。现在的孩子都有车。让我给你们看一款我们刚到的：1996年的轿车。油耗很好，有双安全气囊和防抱死刹车；对年轻驾驶员来说非常完美。

content.en: C: Dad, I love it! It's awesome! Can we get this one please?
content.zh: C：爸，我太喜欢了！太棒了！我们能买这辆吗？

content.en: B: I see... What can you tell me about this one?
content.zh: B：我看看……这辆你能跟我说说吗？

content.en: A: Oh, that's just an old World War Two tank that we use for TV commercials. Now about this sedan...
content.zh: A：哦，那只是一辆我们用来拍电视广告的二战旧坦克。还是来看这辆轿车吧……

content.en: B: Whoa, whoa wait a minute. Tell me more about this tank.
content.zh: B：哇，哇等一下。多跟我说说这辆坦克。

content.en: A: Well, Sir, if you are looking for quality and safety then look no further! Three inches of reinforced steel protect your daughter from short range missile attacks.
content.zh: A：好的先生，如果您追求质量和安全，那就不用再找了！三英寸厚的强化钢可以保护您的女儿免受短程导弹攻击。

content.en: B: Does the sedan protect her from missile attacks?
content.zh: B：轿车能保护她免受导弹攻击吗？

content.en: A: It does not.
content.zh: A：不能。

content.en: B: Well, I don't know. Let me sleep on it.
content.zh: B：嗯，我不确定。让我考虑一晚。

content.en: A: Did I mention the tank is a tank?
content.zh: A：我有没有说过这坦克本身就是一辆坦克？

content.en: B: I'll take it!
content.zh: B：我买了！

content.en: C: Dad!
content.zh: C：爸！

content.en: A: Irene! I heard you were on a date last night! So, how how did it go? I want all the juicy details!
content.zh: A：艾琳！我听说你昨晚去约会了！怎么样怎么样？我要听所有劲爆的细节！

content.en: B: Um... well, actually, we had a fantastic time last night. He was...amazing!
content.zh: B：嗯……好吧，其实，我们昨晚过得特别开心。他……太棒了！

content.en: A: Okay, now you really have to fill me in. What's he like?
content.zh: A：好吧，你现在真得跟我说清楚。他什么样？

content.en: B: He's really good looking; he's quite tall, around 6'1", he's in his early thirties, and he's got the most beautiful dark brown eyes...
content.zh: B：他非常帅；个子挺高，大约6尺1寸，三十出头，有着最漂亮的深棕色眼睛……

content.en: A: He sounds hot! What does he do for a living?
content.zh: A：听起来很性感啊！他做什么工作的？

content.en: B: You know what, this is the best part. David is a junior investment banker at Fortune Bank, so he's got a great career path ahead of him!
content.zh: B：知道吗，这是最棒的部分了。大卫是财富银行的一名初级投资银行家，所以他的职业前景非常光明！

content.en: A: Hold on a sec, his name is David?
content.zh: A：等一下，他叫大卫？

content.en: B: Yeah?
content.zh: B：是啊？

content.en: A: That's my brother!
content.zh: A：那是我哥！

title: Can I ask you a favor?

content.en: A: Um, sorry to bother you, um... my name is Rachel. I'm new here. Can I ask you a favor?
content.zh: A：嗯，抱歉打扰了，嗯……我叫瑞秋。我是新来的。我能请你帮个忙吗？

content.en: B: Hi Rachel, welcome on board. I'm afraid I can't help you right now. I'm getting ready for a very important meeting.
content.zh: B：嗨瑞秋，欢迎加入。恐怕我现在帮不了你。我正为一个非常重要的会议做准备。

content.en: A: Excuse me, but can I bother you for a sec?
content.zh: A：不好意思，能打扰你一下吗？

content.en: C: You know what, I'd love to help you, but I'm about to meet an important client. Do you wanna try Sean instead? He sits right over there.
content.zh: C：你知道吗，我很想帮你，但我马上要去见一个重要的客户。你要不要去找肖恩试试？他就坐在那边。

content.en: A: Sorry to interrupt you Sean, could you do me a quick favor?
content.zh: A：抱歉打扰了肖恩，你能帮我一个小忙吗？

content.en: D: Actually, I'm working on a document that is due in a couple minutes. I really can't talk to you right now. Sorry about that.
content.zh: D：其实我正在赶一份几分钟后就要交的文件。我现在真的没法跟你说话。很抱歉。

content.en: A: Geeze! I just want to know where the bathroom is! What's wrong with you people!
content.zh: A：天哪！我只是想知道洗手间在哪里！你们这些人怎么回事啊！

content.en: A: In a digital world, even the strongest must fight for survival. Two people, possess a secret so valuable, so powerful, they have to defend it at all costs.
content.zh: A：在一个数字世界里，即使是最强大的人也必须为生存而战。两个人，拥有一个如此宝贵、如此强大的秘密，他们必须不惜一切代价保卫它。

content.en: B: I don't care where they are, I don't care what it takes... you find them and bring them to me!
content.zh: B：我不在乎他们在哪，我不惜任何代价……找到他们，把他们带到我面前来！

content.en: A: They only had one chance! And their chance was to fight back!
content.zh: A：他们只有一次机会！而他们选择反击！

content.en: D: You wanna play rough? Okay, say hello to my little friend!
content.zh: D：你想来硬的？好吧，来见见我的小朋友！

content.en: A: With a little help from a Governor...
content.zh: A：在一位州长的一点帮助下……

content.en: C: Listen to me! We have to get them outta there! No matter what!
content.zh: C：听我说！我们必须把他们救出来！无论如何！

content.en: A: Nothing will prevent them from doing their job! Double the action.
content.zh: A：没有什么能阻止他们完成任务！双倍的动作场面。

content.en: D: Get down!
content.zh: D：趴下！

content.en: A: Triple the excitement.
content.zh: A：三倍的刺激。

content.en: D: Get down again!
content.zh: D：再趴下一次！

content.en: A: This summer... nothing will stand in their way.
content.zh: A：这个夏天……没有什么能阻挡他们。

content.en: B: I'm going to make him an offer he can't refuse.
content.zh: B：我要给他一个无法拒绝的条件。

content.en: A: Two hosts, one podcast, coming to a theater near you.
content.zh: A：两个主持人，一个播客，即将在你附近的影院上映。

content.en: A: So, Casey, how are things going with the photos for the press kit?
content.zh: A：那么，凯西，新闻资料包的照片准备得怎么样了？

content.en: B: Yeah, I've been meaning to talk to you about that. I might need to ask for an extension on that deadline.
content.zh: B：是啊，我一直想跟你谈谈这个。我可能需要申请延期。

content.en: A: You've had over a month to get this finalized! Why are things delayed?
content.zh: A：你已经有一个多月时间来完成这件事了！为什么会拖延？

content.en: B: Well, the thing is, we ran into a lot of problems...
content.zh: B：嗯，事情是这样的，我们遇到了很多问题……

content.en: A: I'm not looking for excuses here. I just want to get this finished on time!
content.zh: A：我不是来找借口的。我只想按时完成这件事！

content.en: B: I know, and I apologize for the delay. But some things were just beyond my control. I had trouble booking the photographer, and then Michael was sick for three weeks, so I couldn't include him in the photos, and the design team lost all the files, so I had to re-do the pictures.
content.zh: B：我知道，我为拖延道歉。但有些事情真的不在我控制范围内。我约摄影师遇到困难，然后迈克尔病了三周，所以我没法把他拍进去，然后设计团队丢失了所有文件，我不得不重拍这些照片。

content.en: A: I'm not going to put this off any longer, Casey! I want those photos ASAP!
content.zh: A：我不能再拖了，凯西！我 ASAP 要看到那些照片！

title: Daily Life - Applying for a Visa

content.en: A: So, you're applying for a B2 visa, where is your final destination and what's the purpose of your trip to the United States?
content.zh: A：那么，您申请的是B2签证，您的最终目的地是哪里，您来美国的目的是什么？

content.en: B: I'm going to visit my brother; he's just had a baby. He lives in Minneapolis.
content.zh: B：我要去看我哥哥；他刚生了宝宝。他住在明尼阿波利斯。

content.en: A: And how long do you you plan to remain in the United States?
content.zh: A：您计划在美国停留多长时间？

content.en: B: I'll be here for approximately three weeks. See, here's my return ticket for the twenty-sixth of March.
content.zh: B：我将停留大约三周。你看，这是我的往返机票，3月26号的。

content.en: A: And, who is sponsoring your trip?
content.zh: A：那么，谁资助您的旅行？

content.en: B: My brother, here, this is an invitation letter from him. I will stay with him and his family in their home.
content.zh: B：我哥哥，这是他的邀请函。我会在他家里和他家人住在一起。

content.en: A: Alright, tell me about the ties you have to your home country.
content.zh: A：好的，跟我说说您与祖国的联系。

content.en: B: Well, I own a house; actually, I'm leaving my dog there with my neighbors. I have a car at home, and oh, my job! I'm employed by Tornel as an engineer. Actually, I only have three weeks' vacation, so I have to go back to work at the end of March.
content.zh: B：嗯，我拥有一套房子；实际上，我把我的狗留在了邻居那里。我在家里有辆车，哦，还有我的工作！我受雇于托内尔公司做工程师。实际上，我只有三周假期，所以我三月底必须回去上班。

content.en: A: And what evidence do you ha ve that you arefinancially independent?
content.zh: A：您有什么证据证明您有经济独立能力？

content.en: B: Well, I do have assets in my country; like I said, I own a house, and see, here's a bank statement showing my investments, and my bank balance.
content.zh: B：嗯，我在国内确实有资产；正如我说的，我有一套房子，而且你看，这是我的银行对账单，显示了我的投资和银行余额。

content.en: A: I'm sorry, sir, we cannot grant you a B2 visa at this time, instead, you are granted a resident visa! Congratulations, you are the millionth person to apply for a visa! You win! Congratulations!
content.zh: A：对不起，先生，我们目前无法授予您B2签证，不过，我们将授予您居民签证！恭喜您，您是第一百万人申请签证的人！您中奖了！恭喜！

content.en: A: Morning.
content.zh: A：早。

content.en: B: Hi there Mr. Anderson! How are you on this fine morning?
content.zh: B：早啊安德森先生！今天天气这么好，你还好吗？

content.en: A: Fine, thank you.
content.zh: A：很好，谢谢。

content.en: B: It sure is cold this morning, isn't it? I barely even get 12 out of bed!
content.zh: B：今天早上确实很冷，对吧？我几乎爬不起来！

content.en: A: Yeah. It's pre tty cold, alright.
content.zh: A：是啊，确实挺冷的。

content.en: B: Did you catch the news this morning? I heard that there was a fire on Byron Street.
content.zh: B：你今早看新闻了吗？我听说拜伦街上发生了火灾。

content.en: A: No, I didn't hear about that.
content.zh: A：没有，我没听说。

content.en: B: Did you happen to watch the football game last night? The Patriots scored in the last minute!
content.zh: B：你昨晚碰巧看橄榄球赛了吗？爱国者队在最后一分钟得分了！

content.en: A: No, I don't like football.
content.zh: A：不，我不喜欢橄榄球。

content.en: B: Oh... By the way, I saw you with your daughter at the office Christmas party. Sh e is really beautiful!
content.zh: B：哦……对了，我在办公室圣诞派对上看到你和你的女儿在一起。她真是太漂亮了！

content.en: A: She's my wife! Oh, here's my floor! Nice talking to you. Goodbye.
content.zh: A：那是我老婆！哦，我到了！很高兴跟你聊天。再见。

content.en: B: Sir this is the 56th floor! We are on the 70th!
content.zh: B：先生这是56楼！我们在70楼！

content.en: A: That's okay, I'll take the stairs!
content.zh: A：没关系，我走楼梯！

content.en: A:... so, I said, "let's take a break." And since that night, I've been waiting for him to call, but I still haven't heard from him. You don't think he's seeing someone else, do you?
content.zh: A：……所以我说，「我们先冷静一段时间吧」。从那天晚上起，我就一直在等他打电话，但还是没有他的消息。你不会觉得他在跟别人约会吧？

content.en: B: Come on, don't be so dramatic! I'm sure everything is going to work out just fine.
content.zh: B：拜托，别这么夸张！我相信一切都会好起来的。

content.en: A: You think so? Oh, no! How can he do this to me? I'm sure he's cheating on me! Why else wouldn't he call?
content.zh: A：你这么觉得吗？哦不！他怎么能这样对我？我确定他是在背着我偷吃！不然为什么不打电话？

content.en: B: But, you two are on a break. Theoretically he can do whatever he likes.
content.zh: B：但是，你们俩现在在冷静期啊。理论上他可以做任何他想做的事。

content.en: A: He's the love of my life! I've really messed this up.
content.zh: A：他是我一生的挚爱！我完全把这一切搞砸了。

content.en: B: Come on, hon. Pull yourself together. It's going to be alright.
content.zh: B：拜托，亲爱的。振作起来。一切都会好起来的。

content.en: A: But I... I still love him! And it's all my fault! I can't believe how immature and selfish I was being. I mean, he is a firefighter, it's not like he can just leave someone in a burning building and meet me for dinner. I've totally messed this up!
content.zh: A：但是我……我还爱着他！这都是我的错！我真不敢相信我当初是多么幼稚和自私。我的意思是，他是个消防员，他总不能抛下着火大楼里的人来跟我吃饭吧。我完全搞砸了！

content.en: B: You know what, Veronica, I think you should make the first step. I'm sure he'll forgive you...
content.zh: B：你知道吗，维罗妮卡，我觉得你应该迈出第一步。我相信他会原谅你的……

content.en: A: No, this is not gonna happen! I... I've ruined everything...
content.zh: A：不，这不可能！我……我毁了一切……

content.en: B: Hey... do you hear something? Guess what? It's your lovely firefighter!
content.zh: B：嘿……你听到了吗？你猜怎么着？是你可爱的消防员来了！

content.en: C: When I had you, I treated you bad and wrong dear. And since, since you went away, don't you know I sit around with my head hanging down and I wonder who's loving you.
content.zh: C：当我拥有你的时候，我待你又坏又错亲爱的。自从你离开后，难道你不知道我成天垂头丧气坐着，想知道是谁在爱你。

content.en: A: Help! Are you a doctor? My poor little Frankie has stopped breathing! Oh my gosh, Help me! I tried to perform CPR, but I just don't know if I could get any air into his lungs! Oh, Frankie!
content.zh: A：救命！你是医生吗？我可怜的小弗兰基停止呼吸了！哦天哪，帮帮我！我试过做CPR，但我不知道有没有把空气送入他的肺里！哦，弗兰基！

content.en: B: Ellen, get him hooked up to a monitor! Someone page Dr. Howser. Get the patient to hold still, I can't get a pulse! Okay, he's on the monitor. His BP is falling! He's flatlining!
content.zh: B：艾伦，给他接上监护仪！叫人去呼豪瑟医生。让病人不要动，我摸不到脉搏！好了，监护仪接上了。他的血压在下降！他在室颤！

content.en: A: NOOOOOO! Frankie! Nurse! Do something!
content.zh: A：不——！弗兰基！护士！做点什么啊！

content.en: B: Someone get her out of here! Get me the defibrillator. Okay, clear! Again! Clear! Come on! dammit! I'm not letting you go! Clear! I've got a pulse!
content.zh: B：谁把她弄出去！给我除颤仪。好了，离开！再来！离开！加油！该死！我不会让你走的！离开！有脉搏了！

content.en: C: Okay, what's happening?
content.zh: C：好的，什么情况？

content.en: B: The patient is in acute respiratory failure, I think were going to have to intubate!
content.zh: B：病人处于急性呼吸衰竭，我想我们得插管了！

content.en: C: Alright! Tubes in! Bag him! Someone give him 10 cc's of adrenaline! Let's go, people move, move!
content.zh: C：好！管子进去了！给他通气！谁给他来10cc肾上腺素！快走，大家动起来，动起来！

content.en: A: Doctor, oh, thank god! How is he?
content.zh: A：医生，哦，谢天谢地！他怎么样了？

content.en: B: We managed to stabilize Frankie, but he's not out of the woods yet; he's still in critical condition. Were moving him to intensive care, but...
content.zh: B：我们成功稳住了弗兰基，但他还没脱离危险；他仍处于危急状态。我们正把他转到重症监护室，但是……

content.en: A: Doctor, just do whatever it takes. I just want my little Frankie to be okay. I couldn't imagine life without my little hamster!
content.zh: A：医生，不管付出什么代价都可以。我只想我的小弗兰基没事。我无法想象没有我的小仓鼠的生活！

content.en: A: I called this meeting today in order to discuss our manufacturing plan. As I'm sure you're all aware, with the credit crunch, and the global financial crisis, we're obligated to look for more cost efficient ways of producing our goods. We don't want to have to be looking at redundancies. So, we've outlined a brief plan to implement the just-in-time philosophy.
content.zh: A：我今天召集这个会议是为了讨论我们的生产计划。我相信大家都清楚，随着信贷紧缩和全球金融危机，我们有义务寻找更具成本效益的生产方式。我们不想裁员。所以，我们拟定了一个简要计划来实施「准时制」理念。

content.en: B: We have two basic points that we want to focus on. First of all, we want to reduce our lead time.
content.zh: B：我们有两个基本要点要重点关注。首先，我们想缩短我们的前置时间。

content.en: C: Why would you want to do that? I think this is not an area that really needs to be worked on.
content.zh: C：为什么想要这么做？我觉得这不是一个真正需要改进的领域。

content.en: B: Well, we want to reduce production and delivery lead times for better overall efficiency.
content.zh: B：嗯，我们想减少生产和交付的前置时间以提高整体效率。

content.en: A: Right, production lead times can be reduced by moving work stations closer together, reducing queue length, like for example, reducing the number of jobs waiting to be processed at a given machine, and improving the coordination and cooperation between successive processes. Delivery lead times can be reduced through close cooperation with suppliers, possibly by inducing suppliers to locate closer to the factory or working with a faster shipping company.
content.zh: A：对，生产前置时间可以通过将工作站点布置得更近、减少队列长度来缩短，比如减少等待在某个机器前的作业数量，以及改善前后工序之间的协调与合作。交付前置时间可以通过与供应商的紧密合作来缩短，或许可以引导供应商将工厂设在更近的地方，或者与更快的运输公司合作。

content.en: C: I see... That makes sense.
content.zh: C：我明白了……这很有道理。

content.en: B: The second point is that we want to require supplier quality assurance and implement a zero defects quality program. We currently have far too many errors that lead to defective items and therefore, they must be eliminated. A quality control at the source program must be implemented to give workers the personal responsibility for the quality of the work they do, and the authority to stop production when something goes wrong.
content.zh: B：第二点是我们要求供应商进行质量保证并实施零缺陷质量计划。目前我们有太多的错误导致缺陷产品，因此，必须消除这些错误。必须实施源头质量控制计划，让工人对工作质量承担个人责任，并在出现问题时拥有停产的权力。

content.en: C: I'm with you on this one. It's essential that we reduce these errors; we've got to force our suppliers to reduce their mistakes.
content.zh: C：这一点我同意。减少这些错误至关重要；我们必须强制供应商减少他们的错误。

content.en: A: Exactly. Well, let's look at how we're going to put this plan into action. First...(fade out)

B: Oh, yeah. I'm there!

A: And so, I just wanted to check in with you and find out where we are with this project. As you know, you've missed a fairly significant deadline last week, and this will negativity impact the team's ability to move forward with the next stages of this project.

B: I know, I'm really sorry that I missed the deadline. But really, it wasn't my fault. You see, we had all of these unexpected technical problems at the last minute, and that I couldn't get into the databa se and extract the kind of information that I needed for the data analyis. You know, if the tech guys would have done their job and kept the CRM stable, then I wouldn't have missed my deadline.

A: Oh, come on! An excuse like that is tantamount to lying. You're essentially blaming the tech team for your time management issues, rather than accepting responsibility for the fact that you were pr ocrastinating for the past two weeks.

B: No, I'm not trying to pass the buck here; I know that it was me who is ultimately responsible for getting this done. But the thing is, I could have finished on time if the system hadn't gone down. And you know, with everything I've got going on now, I can't afford to waste time dealing with technical problems. I've got a lot on my plate and there are only twenty-four hours in a day...

A: I'm not going to accept this excuse. You're using these small technical glitches as a crutch and trying to rationalize the fact that you've missed your deadline. Look, we have standards and I expect you to live up to those standards. No more phoney excuses. If you're in over your head, you tell me. No more missed deadlines. Now, I want that data on my desk by nine am!

Steven: It was fine. I've been better but, it's great to be home, I've missed you all! How's mom?
Gulam: She's great! All she ever does is talk about you -her little boy that went to the United States. You're her pride and joy, you know that?
Steven: Can't wait to see her. And you? What's new with you?
Gulam: Well, Nisha and I are expecting! You'll have another nephew or niece soon!
Steven: That's great! Wow! Congrats! You two are great together, ya know. You have such a beautiful family. I hope one day I can have that.
Gulam: Of course, man! Come on! I mean, everything was set here for you to marry Shalini! You know, she's still pining after you. I don't think she'll ever get over you.

Steven: What are you talking about? I hardly knew her! How could she be in love with me? I couldn't go through with it even though she is a great woman. No, I left my heart in the United States. I just hope Veronica is happy.
Gulam: Get over it! You're home now. Everyone here thinks so highly of you; there'll be girls throwing themselves at you. You can marry anyone you want!
Steven: I don't want to marry anyone! I want to marry her! Don't you understand?
Gulam: You are incorrigible.
Liliana: Steven! My baby how are you! I've missed you so much!
Steven: Hey, mom! Great to see you!
Liliana: You look so thin! Didn't those Americans feed you? Come come, let's have some chai. By the way... There is a girl here waiting for you.
Veronica: Hi Steven.
Steven: Veronica! How did you get here? How did you know where I live? I waited for you at the airport but you never showed...

Veronica: I also have some little secrets that I haven't told you about, but we can discuss that later. I realized that I was just scared. Scared of how much I love you and of the commitment that marriage requires. I'm here now. Now there is something I wanna ask you. Steven, will you marry me?
Priest: I now declare you, husband and wife. You may kiss the bride.

A: We now stand ten years past the midpoint of a century that has witnessed four major wars among great nations. Three of these involved our own country. Despite the carnage of these conflicts, America is today the strongest, the most influential and most productive nation in the world. We are understandably proud of this preeminence, yet we realize that America's leadership and prestige depend, not merely upon our unmatched material progress, riches and military strength, but on how we use our power in the interests of world peace and human betterment.

A: Throughout America's adventure in free government, such basic purposes have been to keep the peace; to foster progress in human achievement, and to enhance liberty, dignity and integrity among peoples and among nations.

A: We pray that peoples of all faiths, all races, all nations, may have their great human needs satisfied; that those now denied opportunity shall come to enjoy it to the full; that all who yearn for freedom may experience its spiritual blessings; that those who have freedom will understand, also, its heavy respon sibilities; that all who are insensitive to the needs of others will learn charity; that the scourges of poverty, disease and ignorance will be made to disappear from the earth, and that, in the goodness of time, all peoples will come to live together in a peace guaranteed by the binding force of mutual respect and love.
A: Now, on Friday noon, I am to become a private citizen. I am proud to do so. I look forward to it. Thank you, and good night.

title: Daily Life - Going To The Gym

content.en: A: Hey there, you look a little lost. Are you new here?
B: Yeah how'd you know?
A: You can always spot the newbies. I can give you a few pointers if you want. Were you trying to use this machine here?
B: Yeah! I just started my training today and I'm not really sure where to begin.
A: It's ok, I know how it is. This machine here will work out your upper body, mainly your triceps and biceps. Are you looking to develop strength or muscle tone and definition?
B: Well, I don't want to be ripped like you! I just want a good physique with weights and cardio.

A: In that case you want to work with less weight. You can start off by working ten to fifteen reps in four sets. Five kilo weights should be enough. Now it's very important that you stretch before pumping iron or you might pull a muscle.
B: Got it! Wow is that the weight you are lifting? My goodness that's a lot of weight!
A: It's not that much. Just watch... I'm ok...
A: Okay, next question. If Eric asked you out on a date, what would you say?
B: Duh! I would say yes! Eric is the most popular kid in school! Okay, my turn. What would you do if you won the lottery?
A: Let's see... If I won the lottery, I would buy two tickets for a trip around the world.
B: If you buy me a ticket I will go with you for sure!
A: My dad will freak out if I even mention a trip like that!
B: Alright this is a good one. What would your mom say if you told her you are going to get married?
A: If I told her that, she would faint and have me committed!
A: Howdy! Nice car! What seems to be the problem?
B: I don't know! This stupid old car started spewing white smoke and it just died on me. Luckily, I managed to start it up and drive it here. What do you think it is?
A: Not sure yet. How about you pop the hood and we can take a look. Hmmm, it doesn't look good.
B: What do you mean? My daddy gave me this car for my birthday last month. It's brand new!

A: Well missy, the white smoke that you saw is steam from the radiator. You overheated your engine so now the pistons are busted and so is your transmission. You should have called us and we could have towed you over here when your car died.
B: Ugh... So how long is this going to take? An hour?

A: I'm afraid a bit more than that. We need to order the spare parts, take apart your electrical system, fuel pump and engine and then put it back together again. You are going to have to leave it here for at least two weeks.
B: What! How am I supposed to get to school or go shopping? This is not happening!
A: Ok, let's go through this one more time. I don't want anymore ruined or dyed blouses!
B: I know, I know. OK, so I have to separate the colors from the whites and put them in this strange looking contraption so called washing machine.

A: Right. You have to turn it on and program it depending on what type of clothes you are washing. For example for delicates, you should set a shorter washing cycle. Also, be sure to use fabric softener and this detergent when washing.
B: So complicated! Ok, what about this red wine stain? How do I get it out?
A: Since this is a white t-shirt, you can just pour a little bit of bleach on it and it will do the trick.
B: Cool. Then I can just throw everything in the dryer for an hour and its all set right?
A: No! Since you are washing delicates and cotton, you should set the dryer to medium heat and for twenty minutes.
B: You know what? I'll just have everything dry cleaned.
A: Seriously, I don't know why we need to get a new TV.
B: Honey I told you already. I can't appreciate the graphics level and detail of the games on my Playstation 3 on our old TV.
C: Good afternoon folks! How can I be of service today?
B: I'm looking to upgrade to a newer, bigger television set.
C: You've come to the right place! What size are you looking for?
A: Just a normal sized TV for our living room.

C: I see. Well this set here is on sale. It's a forty six inch HDTV screen and has all the works. Three HDMI connectors, USB, VGA and S - Video ports. It even has a DVI port so you can hook up your PC or laptop! This is without a doubt the complete home theater experience!
B: This is exactly what I need! Can you imagine watching movies or playing video games on this thing?
A: Honey, I think it's a bit too big. I don't even think it will fit in our living room.
C: Not to worry, we will deliver and install it in your home. It comes with a wall mount so you can just hang it on the wall like a picture!
B: This is great! How much will this set me back?
C: Lucky for you, this is the last one we have in stock so it's half off!
B: I'll take it!
A: Ok... I'll talk to you later. Bye
B: Carrie, are you ok? You seem a bit down.
A: I just got off the phone with my boyfriend. He is always getting upset and losing his temper over nothing. It's so hard to talk to him at times.
B: Maybe it's just that he is stressed out from work or something. He does have a pretty nerve wracking job you know.
A: Yeah but, he is always in a really foul mood. I try to find out what's bothering him or get him to talk about his day but, he always shuts down and brushes me off.
B: Men are like that you know. They can feel nervous, anxious or on edge and the only way they can express it is by trying to hide it through aggressiveness.
A: I guess you are right. What do you think I should do? He wasn't always this grouchy you know...
B: Talk to him, try to cheer him up when he is down and if that doesn't work, I say get rid of him and get a new one!
A: You are something else you know that?
A: Did you hear? The state is thinking of legalizing gambling in our city! Soon we are gonna have amazing hotels and casinos here which will be good for our business!
B: Are you serious? Gambling is a vice industry built on deception and fed by the intentional exploitation of human weakness for the sole purpose of monetary gain! It disgusts me.
A: What are you talking about? How does it exploit people?

B: Well, to begin with, Gambling is addictive, ruins marriages, destroys families and bankrupts communities. Once you are addicted it is very difficult to stop. People have lost their houses, cars and been left out on the street after becoming addicted. Secondly, it exploits because men become addicted to gambling most often because of the action and risk. Women gamble to escape, and senior citizens will start gambling for the social interaction. Underage gamblers often start gambling on sports with friends and then illegal bookies.
A: Geez! Now that I think about it, maybe legalizing gambling isn't such a good idea! Although, I have been to Las Vegas, and I didn't become addicted or anything like that.
B: You cannot predict who will become addicted to gambling. Now excuse me, I have a protest rally to organize!
A: Welcome to Galanet. How can I help you?
B: Hi. I would like to get an internet plan for my house.

A: Of course. We have three different plans with different prices you can choose from. The first one is the cheapest but most basic plan which is thirty dollars a month. This is for broadband internet with a download speed of five hundred and twelve kbps.
B: I have no idea what kbps means. I just want to be able to get online, play games and chat with my friends. Oh, and watch movies online as well.

A: Well, this connection might be a bit too slow for your needs. I suggest you get the premium package for fifty dollars a month which includes a connection speed of two megabytes. That way you can play games online without any lag. This package also includes a wireless router and a personal firewall absolutely free!
B: Do I have to pay an installation fee?
A: Lucky for you, this month we aren't charging our normal installation fee. You are saving yourself 100 bucks right there! And we'll throw in this pen drive!
B: Awesome!
